name: EEM Returns by Dollar Regime
description: Monthly EEM returns conditional on U.S. Dollar Index (Broad) strength vs weakness. Dollar regime defined by sign of monthly USD Index change: positive = strong dollar, negative = weak dollar. Outputs: scatter of dollar change vs EEM return, regime return comparison bars, and stats table with N/median/hit rate per regime.
source:
# EEM Returns Conditional on Dollar Strength/Weakness (Monthly)
# Regime: sign of monthly USD Broad Index change
# Question: Does dollar weakness reliably boost EM returns?

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
ts = index().value

# USD Broad Index (daily, FRED)
usd_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='DTWEXBGS')()
usd_daily = ffill(usd_raw.result)

# --- Monthly Aggregation ---
eem_monthly = downsample(target_timeframe=1M)(src.c)
usd_monthly = downsample(target_timeframe=1M)(usd_daily)

# Monthly returns (period=1 on monthly bars = month-over-month)
eem_ret = returns(period=1)(eem_monthly)
usd_ret = returns(period=1)(usd_monthly)

# --- Regime Classification ---
# Dollar strong = positive monthly USD return, weak = negative
is_dollar_strong = is_valid(usd_ret) and usd_ret > 0
is_dollar_weak = is_valid(usd_ret) and usd_ret < 0

# EEM returns split by regime
eem_strong = where(is_dollar_strong, eem_ret)
eem_weak = where(is_dollar_weak, eem_ret)

# Month number for seasonal overlay
month_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month)(ts)
monthly_month = downsample(target_timeframe=1M)(month_num)

# --- Output 1: Scatter — Dollar Change vs EEM Return ---
# The raw relationship: is it monotonic or noisy?
xy_scatter(
    title='Stronger Dollar = Weaker EEM?',
    x_axis_label='Monthly USD Index Change (%)',
    y_axis_label='Monthly EEM Return (%)',
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_dp=1,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    category='Dollar Regime',
    show_trend_line=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=0
)(x=usd_ret, y_values=eem_ret)

# --- Output 2: Regime Return Bars (the punchline) ---
# Median EEM return in strong vs weak dollar months
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    agg=AggregationType.Median,
    title='EEM Median Monthly Return by Dollar Regime',
    y_axis_label='Median Monthly Return',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    category='Dollar Regime',
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Dollar Strong', color=Color.Red),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Dollar Weak', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=1
)(values=(eem_strong, eem_weak))

# --- Output 3: Stats Table ---
# N, median, hit rate, best, worst per regime
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='EEM Monthly Return Stats by Dollar Regime',
        row_size=5, col_size=2,
        row_headers=['Months (N)', 'Median Return', 'Hit Rate (% Positive)', 'Best Month', 'Worst Month'],
        col_headers=['Dollar Strong', 'Dollar Weak'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='Dollar Regime',
    order=2
)(eem_strong, eem_weak, eem_strong, eem_weak, eem_strong, eem_weak, eem_strong, eem_weak, eem_strong, eem_weak)
